title: Benedetto Fantini (DECODE 'Jantini'), Buda and Eger, to the Este court, 1517-1518 (ASMo, Ambasciatori, Ungheria b. 4, Fantini nos. 5-6; DECODE R1126, R1127; catalogue 156)

steps.what: Fetched DECODE R1126/R1127 metadata and images; Vestigia search found Fantini's whole file (V1846-V1852), all images fetched.
Sender identified as Benedetto Fantini (DECODE misreads 'Jantini'), Ferrarese agent in Ippolito d'Este's household; only nos. 5 and 6 contain cipher, and no decipherment is in the file.
Column transcription (upper sign / base stroke) of R1126 p. 1, 18 cipher lines, 581 columns.
Homophonic anneal (it-cinquecento 4-grams, unigram penalty) over p. 1 columns, with the frequent 7g/7y signs kept, merged, or treated as nulls: 6 restarts x 60k moves each.

Statistics: the three-column run 7 / g / m-with-b recurs 14 times and 7g or 7y occurs 45 times in 581 columns, too often for one letter per column; 7g and 7y behave like word signs. The unit of the cipher is unresolved.
Web search and the Bonzagni 1512 and Caprile 1519 Este-Hungary siblings for a printed decipherment or shared key: Bonzagni is a different alphabet, Caprile's 1519 key is itself not built.
Second independent readings of p. 1 and p. 2 (agreement 90% and 76%); all disagreements adjudicated on the images; combined 1,258 units.
Synthetic Italian homophonic text, 1,190 tokens/90 symbols: 98.7% recovered clean, 92% at 5% label noise, 27% at 10-15%.
Anneal on the adjudicated text under seven unit models (per-unit letter, 7-9 merged, bare 7 null, upper only, brackets as word codes, CV syllabary, Caprile/che pins); seeds disagree, no Italian.

outcome.notes: Attempted, open. Both cipher pages double-transcribed and adjudicated; controls show the solver needs <5% transcription error and the residual is about 5-8%; no unit model converges. Needs a key or crib (Caprile 1519 key), better images, or a third reading of p. 2.

prior.where: No decipherment or clear copy in the Vestigia file (Fantini nos. 1-7); none found in print

human: Selected the target; the DECODE session cookie was supplied earlier.
